description: This file defines the class Smarty_Internal_Compile_Private_Object_Function, which is a part of the Smarty template engine's internal compilation plugin. It handles compiling code for registered object functions or properties within Smarty templates.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_Compile_Private_Object_Function
classes.description: Class responsible for compiling code for object functions or properties within Smarty templates. It generates PHP code to invoke object methods with optional parameter handling and supports modifiers and variable assignment.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Compiles PHP code to invoke a registered object method or property within a Smarty template. It handles attribute processing, method verification, parameter conversion, and output generation, including support for modifiers and assignment.
